newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korea's Hanwha brings forward CDU maintenance.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hanwha brings forward CDU maintenance.

text.p: South Korea's Hanwha Energy Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had brought forward to September 7 the two-week maintenance of its 75,000 barrels per day (bpd) number one crude distillation unit (CDU).
A spokesman said the unit had been originally scheduled for turnaround starting September 20.
"There is no particular reason for bringing the maintenance forward," the spokesman said over the telephone from Seoul. "We felt it was more convenient to have it earlier than scheduled."
Hanwha, South Korea's smallest oil refiner in terms of production, has a refining capacity of 275,000 bpd. South Korea's oil refining capacity totals 2.02 million bpd.
